responsibility: Provides lightweight trait-hierarchy elaboration helpers used for diagnostics and pretty-printing, expanding a trait reference through its declared super-predicates and exposing iterators over the implied clauses or only the implied supertraits without depending on the fuller inference-side elaborator.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/util.rs`, this `util.rs` is narrowly scoped to trait-specific traversal: it builds a small elaborator over `super_predicates_of` to walk declared supertraits and implied clauses for pretty-printing/diagnostic use, rather than hosting general-purpose type-system helper routines.
